moves.name: Struggle
moves.effect: Take 5% recoil damage after each use.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: The user charges into the target with its body.

moves.name: Focus
moves.effect: Raises the user's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.description: The user focuses its attention, raising its accuracy by 1 stage.

moves.name: Disarm
moves.effect: Lowers the target's defense by 1 stage.
moves.description: The user disarms the target, lowering its defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Brace
moves.effect: Raises the user's defense by 1 stage.
moves.description: The user braces itself, raising its defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Burst
moves.description: The user fires a burst of energy at the target.

moves.name: Calm Down
moves.effect: Raises the user's special defense by 1 stage.
moves.description: The user calms itself, raising its special defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Pump Up
moves.effect: Raises the user's attack by 1 stage.
moves.description: The user pumps itself up, raising its attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.effect: Raises the user's special attack by 1 stage.
moves.description: The user psyches itself up, raising its special attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Leg Stretch
moves.effect: Raises the user's speed by 1 stage.
moves.description: The user stretches its legs, raising its speed by 1 stage.

moves.name: Wood Double
moves.effect: The user loses 1/16 of its MAX HP to create a wooden decoy in front of its active slot. The decoy has HP equal to the HP spent to create it. While the decoy remains, all techniques used against the user are directed to the decoy instead, preventing their damage and effects from affecting the user. The decoy breaks when its HP reaches 0 or the user leaves the active slot for any reason.
moves.description: The user creates a wooden double to take techniques in its place.

moves.name: Root Whip
moves.description: The user whips the target with a root.

moves.name: Heat Puff
moves.description: The user blows a puff of hot air at the target.

moves.name: Water Burst
moves.description: The user blasts the target with a burst of water.

moves.name: Startle
moves.effect: Lowers the target's speed and special defense by 1 stage. Fails if not used on the first turn in the active slot.
moves.description: The user startles the target immediately after entering the battle.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: The user slashes at the target with claws made of shadows.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The user slashes at the target with a sharp item or claws.

moves.name: Rain Call
moves.effect: Causes rain for 5 turns.
moves.description: The user calls for rain that lasts for 5 turns.

moves.name: Sing
moves.effect: Target is put to sleep for 2 to 5 turns.
moves.description: The user sings a peaceful song which soothes the target to sleep.

moves.name: Cosplay
moves.effect: The user imitates the target's standard skill until it swaps out or faints. If the skill that the user attempts to copy is labeled as non-copyable this technique will always fail.
moves.description: The user imitates the target's active skill by cosplaying as the target.

moves.name: Method Act
moves.effect: The user imitates the target's hidden skill until it swaps out or faints. If the skill that the user attempts to copy is labeled as non-copyable or the target does not currently have their hidden skill this technique will always fail.
moves.description: The user imitates the target's hidden skill by method acting as the target.

moves.name: Splash
moves.effect: The target is given the condition of Soaked until either hit by a Pyro technique or swapped out which makes them weak to Electro techniques.
moves.description: The user splashes water at the target dealing a little damage and making them Soaked.

moves.name: Heart Song
moves.effect: When this technique is used, if the user has a non-Audio Affinity that the target is weak to, this technique uses that Affinity’s offensive matchup instead and its power becomes 80.
moves.description: The user sings a song from deep within their heart allowing the song to take on a different affinity.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.effect: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns.
moves.description: The user kicks up a sandstorm that lasts for 5 turns.

moves.name: Spatial Warp
moves.effect: For 5 turns, the order in which techniques are used is inverted. Lower-priority techniques are used before higher-priority techniques, and within the same priority, slower Enitoy act before faster Enitoy.
moves.description: The user creates a warped pocket of time around the battlefield that inverts the move order for 5 turns.

moves.name: Spike Trap
moves.effect: Spikes are set up on the opponent’s side of the battlefield. Whenever an Enitoy switches in, it loses 1/16 of its maximum HP.
moves.description: The user coats the opponent's side in spikes that damage them upon switching out.

moves.name: Resin Shards
moves.effect: Shards are set up on the opponent’s side of the battlefield. Whenever an Enitoy switches in, it loses 1/16 of its maximum HP.
moves.description: The user coats the opponent's side in shards of resin that damage them upon switching out.

moves.name: Rocky Footing
moves.effect: Rocks are set up on the opponent’s side of the battlefield. Whenever an Enitoy switches in, it loses 1/16 of its maximum HP.
moves.description: The user coats the opponent's side in rocks that damage them upon switching out.

moves.name: Thorny Vines
moves.effect: Thorny vines are set up on the opponent’s side of the battlefield. Whenever an Enitoy switches in, it loses 1/16 of its maximum HP, and the user’s active Enitoy recovers HP equal to the damage dealt.
moves.description: Thorny vines coat the opponent's side of the battlefield that sap a small amount of health upon switching out.

moves.name: Deep Clean
moves.effect: The target becomes Soaked until it is hit by a Pyro technique or switches out, making it weak to Electro techniques. If the target has the Terra, Toxic, or Umbra affinity, those affinities are also removed until the target switches out or faints. If this would leave the target with no affinity, it gains Ordinary instead.
moves.description: The user used water to clean the target on a fundamental level.

skills.name: All-terrain
skills.effect: While any terrain is active, when this Enitoy uses a technique whose stitching matches that terrain, the technique receives a 20% boost and this Enitoy moves faster than normal for that turn.

skills.name: Analytic
skills.effect: Techniques  with less than 100% accuracy gain 20 percentage points of accuracy, up to 100%, but deal 25% less damage.

skills.name: Ancient Echo
skills.effect: When this Enitoy enters battle, its special defense is raised by 1 stage. The first time it falls to half of its MAX HP or less each battle, it restores 20% of its MAX HP.

skills.name: Anger Prone
skills.effect: Techniques used against this Enitoy that make contact have a 20% chance to raise this Enitoy's attack, defense, and special defense by 1 stage.

skills.name: Berry Pouch
skills.effect: The first time each battle this Enitoy's held berry activates, its effect occurs normally, but the berry is not consumed. It cannot activate again from the same triggering event. The next time it activates, it is consumed normally.

skills.name: Chlorophyll
skills.effect: When this Enitoy is hit by a contact technique it is not immune to, it drains 5% of the attacker's current HP, rounded up. During harsh sunlight, it also restores 10% of its MAX HP at the end of each turn.

skills.name: Cushioned Body
skills.effect: This Enitoy takes 20% less damage from contact techniques.

skills.name: Cute Defense
skills.effect: When This Enitoy enters battle, the opponent's defense is lowered by 1 stage.

skills.name: Down Pour
skills.effect: When this Enitoy enters battle, it will cause rain which lasts 7 turns.

skills.name: Dream Catcher
skills.effect: At the end of each turn, if this Enitoy is active and at least one Enitoy on the opposing side is asleep, an effect occurs based on how many turns this Enitoy has been active, counting the turn it entered battle. On odd-numbered turns, this Enitoy restores 5% of its MAX HP. On even-numbered turns, one of its stats that is not already at +6 is chosen at random and raised by 1 stage. If all of its stats are at +6, nothing happens.

skills.name: Dreamy Aura
skills.effect: While this Enitoy is in the active slot or an adjacent slot, Ordinary techniques used by its side become Lux, and Lux and Mental techniques used by its side receive a 25% boost. This skill becomes inactive while an Enitoy with Nightmare Aura is in the active slot or an adjacent slot.

skills.name: Echolocating
skills.effect: Audio techniques used by this Enitoy ignore accuracy checks but deal 20% less damage.

skills.name: Freshly Baked
skills.effect: When This Enitoy uses a Pyro technique, this Enitoy and its allies heal for 5% MAX HP if not fainted.

skills.name: Flash Frozen
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses a Cold technique, this Enitoy and its allies heal for 5% MAX HP if not fainted.

skills.name: Future Energy
skills.effect: When this Enioty enters battle, its special attack and speed are raised by 1 stage. If the field is not already electrified, the field becomes electrified.

skills.name: Healer
skills.effect: When this Enitoy is in the active slot, if at least one ally is poisoned cure a random poisoned ally's poison.

skills.name: Hydration
skills.effect: When hit by a Hydro technique, instead of taking damage restore 10% of MAX HP and restore 10% at the end of turns during rain but only in the active slot.

skills.name: Illuminate
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses a technique that lowers accuracy, that technique ignores accuracy checks.

skills.name: Intense Heat
skills.effect: When this Enitoy is hit by a Pyro technique, it takes no damage and its special attack is raised by 1 stage. Otherwise when it is hit contact technique it is not immune to, there is a 30% chance to inflict burn on the attacker.

skills.name: Keen Processor
skills.effect: Prevents this Enitoy's accuracy or evasion from being lowered by techniques, skills, or other effects.

skills.name: Klutzy
skills.effect: Prevents this Enitoy from holding an item, but makes it so being confused hurts the opponent instead of themself.

skills.name: Living Moment
skills.effect: At the end of each turn, if this Enitoy is active, one of its lowered stats is chosen at random and returned to 0 stages. If none of its stats are lowered, it restores 5% of its MAX HP instead.

skills.name: Loyal Offense
skills.effect: When This Enitoy enters battle, if at least one of its allies were defeated this battle, attack and special attack are raised by 1 stage.

skills.name: Master Chef
skills.effect: Healing techniques used by this Enitoy that target allies heal 10% more, while the techniques gain a 20% chance to burn or freeze opponents.

skills.name: Mindscape Nexus
skills.effect: While two allied Enitoy with this skill are in the active slot or adjacent slot, the active Enitoy restores 5% of its MAX HP at the end of each turn and all of its techniques receive a 15% boost.

skills.name: Murky Ambush
skills.effect: When this Enitoy enters battle while in water or during rain, its speed and evasion are raised by 1 stage each. While this Enitoy is in water or rain is active, its Umbra techniques receive a 20% boost.

skills.name: Nightmare Aura
skills.effect: While this Enitoy is in the active slot or an adjacent slot, Ordinary techniques used by its side become Umbra, and Umbra and Pyro techniques used by its side receive a 25% boost. This skill becomes inactive while an Enitoy with Dreamy Aura is in the active slot or an adjacent slot.

skills.name: Possessed Idol
skills.effect: This Enitoy takes 20% less damage from contact techniques. It also cannot be forcibly moved out of the active slot by techniques or skills.

skills.name: Premonition
skills.effect: When this Enitoy enters battle, it is alerted if the opponent knows any techniques that are super effective against it.

skills.name: Prickily
skills.effect: When this Enitoy is hit by a technique that makes contact, the attacker is also hurt for 10% the damage dealt to this Enitoy

skills.name: Resonant
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses an Ordinary technique, it uses the Audio matchup instead if the target would take more damage from Audio than from Ordinary.

skills.name: Scavenge
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses a physical technique while not holding an item, it has a 15% chance to obtain a random item based on what kind of location the fight takes place.

skills.name: Sharp Edge
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses slashing techniques, those techniques receive a 20% boost and cannot miss.

skills.name: Soothing Glow
skills.effect: If an ally that is asleep is weak to the opponent's stitching, the sleeping Enitoy restores 15% of its MAX HP at the end of each turn, even if this Enitoy is not in the active slot.

skills.name: Soundproof
skills.effect: This Enioty is immune to Audio techniques and other sound-based techniques.

skills.name: Speed Up
skills.effect: At the end of every second consecutive turn this Enitoy spends in the active slot, its speed is raised by 1 stage.

skills.name: Static Shock
skills.effect: Techniques used against this Enitoy that make contact have a 20% chance to paralyze the attacker.

skills.name: Sweet Dreams
skills.effect: At the end of each turn, if at least one other Enitoy in this Enitoy's party is asleep, all sleeping party members restore 5% of their MAX HP. If this Enitoy is active, all sleeping party members and this Enitoy instead restore 10% of their MAX HP.

skills.name: Trickster
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses a non-damaging technique, it moves faster than normal for that turn.

skills.name: Wicked Echo
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses an Audio technique, it uses the Umbra matchup if the target qould take more damage from Umbra than from Audio.

skills.name: Wicked Gaze
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses a Lux technique, it uses the Umbra matchup instead if the target would take more damage from Umbra than from Lux.

skills.name: Wicked Hearing
skills.effect: When this Enitoy is hit by an Audio technique, it takes no damage and its attack, special attack, and speed are raised by 1 stage.

skills.name: Wicked Sight
skills.effect: When this Enitoy is hit by a Lux technique, it take no damage and its attack, special attack, and speed are raised by 1 stage.

skills.name: Wicked Speech
skills.effect: When this Enitoy is hit by an Aero technique, it takes no damage and its attack, special attack, and speed are raised by 1 stage.

skills.name: Wicked Voice
skills.effect: When this Enitoy uses an Aero technique, it uses the Umbra matchup instead if the target would take more damage from Umbra than from Aero.

defects.name: Dimmed Glow
defects.effect: Lux techniques used by this Enitoy deal 20% less damage, but have a 20% chance to raise evasion by 1 stage.

defects.name: Faulty Filter
defects.effect: Toxic techniques used by this Enitoy have a 20% boost but have a 20% chance to randomly poison this Enitoy, the opponent, or both.

defects.name: Faulty Wire
defects.effect: When This Enitoy attempts to use a physical technique, there is a 20% chance that it is unable to act and the technique fails. When this Enitoy is hit by a technique that makes contact, the attacker loses 5% of its MAX HP and has a 30% chance to become paralyzed.

defects.name: Loose Debris
defects.effect: When this Enitoy is hit by a contact technique, an entry hazard is setup on both sides of the field.

defects.name: Loose Feathers
defects.effect: When this Enitoy uses a contact technique or has a contact technique used against it, loose feathers coat the opponent, lowering the opponent's speed by 1 stage.

defects.name: Poor Camouflage
defects.effect: When this Enitoy enters battle, its evasion is lowered by 1 stage and Plant techniques used by this Enitoy have a 20% boost.

defects.name: Over-Absorbent
defects.effect: Hydro Techniques used by this Enitoy deal 20% less damage. When this Enitoy uses or hit by a Hydro technique, this Enitoy has both its defense and special defense raised by 1 stage and its speed lowered by 1 stage.

defects.name: Overcharged
defects.effect: Electro techniques use by this Enitoy have a 20% boost but deal 5% recoil to this Enitoy.

defects.name: Overstuffed
defects.effect: When this Enitoy enters battle, its defense is raised by 1stage and its speed is lowered by 1 stage. Whenever this Enitoy eats a berry, this Enitoy's speed is lowered by 1 stage and its defense if raised by 1 stage.

defects.name: Runny Paint
defects.effect: When this Enitoy uses a technique, before the technique is used this Enitoy coats itself in paint which changes it stitching to match the technique they are about to use.

defects.name: Sleepless
defects.effect: This Enitoy is unable to be put to sleep.

defects.name: Slippery
defects.effect: When this Enitoy enters battle they have their speed raised by 1 stage and their accuracy lowered by 1 stage. When this Enitoy uses or is hit by a Hydro technique their speed is raised by 1 stage and their accuracy is lowered by 1 stage.

defects.name: Split Seam
defects.effect: When this Enitoy is hit by a physical technique, there is a 20% chance its defense will be lowered by 1 stage and its speed will be raised by 1 stage.

defects.name: Squeaky Speaker
defects.effect: When this Enitoy uses an Audio technique, there is a 20% chance to randomly confuse this Enitoy, the opponent, or both for 2 to 5 turns.

defects.name: Wobbly Balance
defects.effect: When this Enitoy enters battle its speed stat is rasied by 1 stage, but all physical techniques used by it are 20% less accurate with a 10% boost.

items.name: Terracotta Mask

enitoys.name: Robond
enitoys.info: Robond seek out Tamers with whom they can form a strong bond. If a Robond follows you, it is seen as a good omen. However, if you approach a Robond and it flees from you, it is seen as a bad omen that calls for self-improvement.

nameOrigins.description: an automatic machine that can sense its environment, make decisions, and take physical action
a deep, enduring psychological connection between two people that carries real emotional weight and mutual care

enitoys.name: Amigearoot
enitoys.info: Amigearoot carefully tend to plants and will often repair damaged roots with their mechanical hands. They become especially protective of Tamers who show patience and kindness toward living things.

nameOrigins.description: Spanish for friend
a toothed wheel in a machine that transmits power and changes speed or direction, or to the equipment and clothing used for a specific activity
The part of a plant that grows below the ground, holds it in place, and takes in water and food

enitoys.name: Mechalsamity
enitoys.info: Plants grow across Mechalsamity's body as it patrols the forests under its protection. It cares tenderly for endangered life but shows no mercy to those it believes threaten the ecosystem. It is often regarded as a dangerous guardian.

nameOrigins.description: giant, piloted or sentient robotic and mechanical vehicles
a dark, sweet, and tangy condiment made from freshly crushed grape juice
a peaceful and friendly relationship between people, groups, or countries

enitoys.name: Amigearoast
enitoys.info: Amigearoast generate intense heat inside their bodies and release it through vents when excited. They are energetic, competitive, and quick to defend any Tamer they consider a close friend.

nameOrigins.description: Spanish for friend
a toothed wheel in a machine that transmits power and changes speed or direction, or to the equipment and clothing used for a specific activity
To cook food (like meat or vegetables) uncovered in an oven or over an open fire using dry, indirect heat

enitoys.name: Mecharmity
enitoys.info: Mecharmity draws dangerous fires into its body before they can spread. The heat it stores can be unleashed as burning flames or caustic smoke against anything it judges harmful to the ecosystem.

nameOrigins.description: giant, piloted or sentient robotic and mechanical vehicles
to burn or blacken the surface of something slightly
a peaceful and friendly relationship between people, groups, or countries

enitoys.name: Amigearinse
enitoys.info: Amigearinse store clean water inside special tanks throughout their bodies. They use it to wash away dirt, cool overheated machinery, and care for Tamers who have earned their trust.

nameOrigins.description: Spanish for friend
a toothed wheel in a machine that transmits power and changes speed or direction, or to the equipment and clothing used for a specific activity
to wash something with clean water to remove soap, dirt, or loose particles

enitoys.name: Mechainmity
enitoys.info: Mechainmity rushes toward fires and drenches them with water stored throughout its body. It uses any water left over to cultivate lush gardens throughout its territory and ferociously defends them from anything it perceives as a threat.

nameOrigins.description: giant, piloted or sentient robotic and mechanical vehicles
liquid water that condenses from water vapor in the atmosphere and falls to Earth in drops
a peaceful and friendly relationship between people, groups, or countries

enitoys.name: Mework
enitoys.info: Mework are adorable little stuffed kitten plush toys brought to life. However, because they are inhabited by the spirits of cats they are able to use claws and teeth not sewn into the original plush toy. If you feed a Mework, they will loyally follow you until the ends of the Earth.

nameOrigins.description: the soft, high-pitched crying sound made by a cat or kitten
a piece of cloth made by sewing together many smaller pieces of different colors and patterns, or a mixture of diverse parts

enitoys.name: Pluschro
enitoys.info: Pluschro are often seen disappearing into the afterlife for short periods of time. It is believed they are visiting the deceased to show them love. On rare occasions, Pluschro have been seen to disappear holding a ball of yarn only to reappear a couple of hours later wearing freshly knitted clothes from the same yarn.

nameOrigins.description: a thick, soft fabric similar to velvet, a soft stuffed toy, or something very luxurious and expensive
The last name of Erwin Schrödinger a famous theoretical physicist who developed fundamental results in quantum theory most known for "Schrödinger's cat"

enitoys.name: Bakatail
enitoys.info: Bakatail are often seen as tricksters that play many tricks upon unsuspecting children who have wandered far from home at night. As a result, it is a common phrase to say "Blinded by a Bakatail's cloth", which means that a person has fallen for a terrible or dumb trick that should have been obvious.

nameOrigins.description: a cat trickster yokai
a corruption of the word cat for spelling
the flexible rear appendage on an animal's body

enitoys.name: Chicadet
enitoys.info: Chicadet are small wind-up bird toys brought to life by the spirits of young songbirds. The key on their backs turns rapidly while they fly, producing a soft ticking sound. Although their songs are simple, they practice them constantly until every note is perfect.

nameOrigins.description: a baby bird, especially a newly hatched chicken
a young person who is training to become an officer in the military, police force, or other uniformed services

enitoys.name: Chimajor
enitoys.info: Chimajor develop music-box components within their chests as they modify. The sound of their wings is accompanied by clear chimes that change pitch depending on how fast they fly. Groups of Chimajor often practice together until their songs are perfectly synchronized.

nameOrigins.description: a clear, ringing, musical tone or a series of harmonious notes produced by striking a bell, metal tube, or similar object
greater in size, rank, importance, or seriousness

enitoys.name: Aviaestro
enitoys.info: Aviaestro possess complex music-box mechanisms throughout their bodies. By controlling the movement of their wings, feathers, and internal gears, they can perform entire melodies without opening their beaks. Other Enitoy often gather in silence to listen when an Aviaestro begins to play.

nameOrigins.description: relating to, characteristic of, or connected with birds
a person who has great skill and mastery in an art, most commonly a composer, teacher, or conductor of music

enitoys.name: Hootton
enitoys.info: Hootton are soft owl plush toys that remain almost completely silent while flying. They often perch in dark places and quietly observe everything around them. When they trust someone, they will wrap their wings around them like a warm blanket.

nameOrigins.description: the low, rhythmic call made by an owl
a soft, white, fluffy fiber that grows around the seeds of warm-climate plants and is used to make thread, yarn, and fabric

enitoys.name: Telekniturnal
enitoys.info: Teleknitural use their psychic power to move their large plush bodies through the air without flapping their wings. They can manipulate loose threads and stuffing as though they were extra limbs. It is said they can sense a person's intentions before that person acts.

nameOrigins.description: a purported psychic ability to move or change physical objects using only the power of the mind, without any physical contact
to make a fabric or garment by interlacing yarn with needles
being active, happening, or relating to the night rather than during the day

enitoys.name: Riduni
enitoys.info: Riduni travel by balancing atop balls made from dung, mud, and small stones. They often wobble, crash, or roll in the wrong direction, but they quickly repair their balls and try again. A Riduni that can ride without falling is considered ready to modify.

nameOrigins.description: to travel by sitting on an animal or inside a vehicle
solid waste or fecal droppings passed by animals
a one-wheeled vehicle that a person rides by sitting on a seat and pedaling

enitoys.name: Terrhidung
enitoys.info: Terrhidung compress dung and mud into two tough, wheel-shaped balls that allow them to race across almost any terrain. They steer by turning their handlebar-shaped horns and shifting their weight between the two wheels. Terrhidung sometimes allow trusted Tamers to ride on their backs.

nameOrigins.description: a specific area of land and the physical features or shape of its surface
herbivorous insects named for the horn-like projections on and around the males' heads
solid waste or fecal droppings passed by animals

enitoys.name: Duscara
enitoys.info: Despite being bugs that might be expected to terrify small children, Duscara are often seen as calming. The faint glow from the ends of their abdomens has even been observed soothing restless children to sleep when they are afraid of the dark.

nameOrigins.description: the time of day immediately following sunset when the sky begins to grow dark
A beetle of the species Scarabaeus sacer, sacred to the ancient Egyptians

enitoys.name: Soothorlax
enitoys.info: Duscara that modify into Soothorlax can emit a glow capable of calming even the darkest nightmares in full-grown adults. Soothorlax tend to glow brighter when fed delicious honey and warm milk before bed, while they glow dimmer when fed blander foods.

nameOrigins.description: (transitive) To restore to ease, comfort, or tranquility; relieve; calm; quiet; refresh
(anatomy) The region of the mammalian body between the neck and abdomen as well as the cavity containing the heart and lungs
to become calm

enitoys.name: Domustel
enitoys.info: Domustel love to curl up among ordinary stuffed toys, making them difficult to notice until they begin to move. They quickly grow attached to anyone who plays with them and often hide in bags, sleeves, or blankets to follow their favorite companion.

nameOrigins.description: Of or relating to the home
A taxonomic family within the order Carnivora – otters, badgers, honey badgers, weasels, etc

enitoys.name: Comustelux
enitoys.info: A Comustelux's markings glow brighter when it senses that its companion is afraid or lonely. It wraps its long plush body around those it trusts, using its soft light and gentle presence to help them feel safe.

nameOrigins.description: A friend, acquaintance or partner; someone with whom one spends time or accompanies
A taxonomic family within the order Carnivora – otters, badgers, honey badgers, weasels, etc
In the International System of Units, the derived unit of illuminance or illumination; one lumen per square metre. Symbol: lx

enitoys.name: Ogrio
enitoys.info: Ogrio are small ogre-like Enitoy known for their sharp temper and quick movements. When angered, static energy begins to crackle around their horns and hair. Despite their attitude, they become fiercely protective of Tamers who earn their respect.

nameOrigins.description: (mythology, folklore) A large, grotesque, brutish humanoid monster, typically marked by great strength and a propensity to kill or devour humans
A Japanese girl name

enitoys.name: Rionight
enitoys.info: After modifying, Rionight become faster and more confident, using bursts of static energy to overwhelm their opponents. They take great pride in their strength and will challenge anything they believe has insulted them or their Tamer.

nameOrigins.description: A Japanese girl name
a large, fierce type of demon, ogre, or yōkai (supernatural spirit) from Japanese folklore
(countable, uncountable) Power, strength, force, or influence held by a person or group

enitoys.name: Ogryo
enitoys.info: Ogryo are stocky ogre-like Enitoy that often try to prove their strength through rough play and friendly competition. Their anger causes static energy to build inside their bodies, making their hair and horns spark when they become excited.

nameOrigins.description: (mythology, folklore) A large, grotesque, brutish humanoid monster, typically marked by great strength and a propensity to kill or devour humans
A Japanese boy name

enitoys.name: Ryonight
enitoys.info: Ryonight are powerful oni Enitoy that rely on toughness and endurance to outlast their opponents. The static energy stored within their bodies erupts when they are struck, and they are known to defend their Tamers with relentless determination.

nameOrigins.description: A Japanese boy name
a large, fierce type of demon, ogre, or yōkai (supernatural spirit) from Japanese folklore
(countable, uncountable) Power, strength, force, or influence held by a person or group

enitoys.name: Kappabe
enitoys.info: Kappabe get their name from a legend about ghosts from a faraway land that were referred to as kappas. However, not long after, it was discovered that they were actually Kappabe, and the name has since stuck across all regions.

nameOrigins.description: a familiar type of water monster
(now literary or poetic) A baby or infant; a very young human or animal

enitoys.name: Lilad
enitoys.info: Male Kappabe seem to be able to modify only into this more masculine species. Lilad tend to resemble small human boys, and some theorize they use this resemblance to drown similarly sized human children and replace them.

nameOrigins.description: an informal short form of the word "little"
a boy, young man, or male friend

enitoys.name: Kawateronin
enitoys.info: Often referred to as ronin of the water, these strange Enitoy devote themselves to a single master. When they no longer serve that master, their former Tamers swear they can still feel a Kawateronin's eyes watching them from the shadows at night, leaving them unable to sleep peacefully.

nameOrigins.description: another name for kappas
a clear, colorless, odorless, and tasteless liquid compound
"wave man" in Japanese, symbolizing a drifter or a wanderer tossed about like an ocean wave

enitoys.name: Lilass
enitoys.info: Female Kappabe seem to be able to modify only into this more feminine species. Lilass tend to resemble small human girls, and some theorize they use this resemblance to hypnotize similarly sized human children and replace them.

nameOrigins.description: an informal short form of the word "little"
A girl; also (by extension), a young woman

enitoys.name: Yokawater
enitoys.info: Often referred to as witches of the water, these strange Enitoy devote themselves to learning to dance with ocean waves and falling rain. Their dances can cause the very heavens to send rain down. Seeing a Yokawater during a harsh drought is often considered a blessing, though not one that comes without a price.

nameOrigins.description: (folklore, Japanese mythology) Any of various supernatural monsters, sometimes shapeshifters, in Japanese folklore
another name for kappas
a clear, colorless, odorless, and tasteless liquid compound

enitoys.name: Kalamarky
enitoys.info: Kalamarky often use paints created from crushed berries to make fun doodles. However, they do not seem to care where they place their artwork. Kalamarky doodles can often be found on trees, rocks, and other surfaces near their territory. Be warned: you will never see just one Kalamarky, as they travel in schools.

nameOrigins.description: (cooking) Squid as food, especially cooked in the form of calamari rings
a visible sign, symbol, or blemish on a surface

enitoys.name: Octopaint
enitoys.info: When Kalamarky modify into Octopaint, their simple doodles develop into full-fledged works of art and masterpieces. There was once an Octopaint so talented at painting that it created a fake tunnel on a wall that actually fooled people. The scientific name for an Octopaint is Octopaint vulgarinum.

nameOrigins.description: A taxonomic genus within the family Octopodidae – typical octopuses
A substance that is applied as a liquid or paste, and dries into a solid coating that protects or adds colour to an object or surface to which it has been applied

enitoys.name: Lapaws
enitoys.info: Lapaws are quiet rabbit Enitoy that rarely make any sound beyond the soft tapping of their paws. They will often sit near musicians and listen intently, though they seem unable to understand why the sounds affect them so deeply. When a Lapaws finally attempts to sing, it may begin to modify.

nameOrigins.description: French for rabbit
the soft foot of an animal that has claws or nails

enitoys.name: Melapinna
enitoys.info: Melapinna have discovered a deep love of music and spend hours practicing songs they have heard. Their large ears can detect even the smallest change in pitch, allowing them to copy nearly any melody. As their musical tastes develop, they eventually modify to reflect the genre they love most.

nameOrigins.description: A sequence of notes that makes up a musical phrase
French for rabbit
(anatomy, zoology) The visible part of the ear in most therians that resides outside of the head, the auricle; outer ear excluding the ear canal

enitoys.name: Tontaudisco
enitoys.info: Tontaudisco perform fast techno music using synthesized sounds and static energy generated throughout their bodies. Their ears flash in time with the beat, while their rapid footwork can turn any open space into a dance floor. Groups of Tontaudisco are known to hold raves that continue until sunrise.

nameOrigins.description: a small, wild North American rabbit with brownish-gray fur and a short, fluffy tail that is white on the underside
Focused on audible sound, as opposed to sight
an upbeat style of dance music and cultural movement

enitoys.name: Tontaudoll
enitoys.info: Tontaudoll develop polished voices, brilliant costumes, and expressions so perfect that they can appear almost like living dolls. They devote themselves to entertaining their audiences and will continue performing even when exhausted. The light they produce grows brighter when they hear their fans cheering.

nameOrigins.description: a small, wild North American rabbit with brownish-gray fur and a short, fluffy tail that is white on the underside
Focused on audible sound, as opposed to sight
A small figure resembling a human being that is used as a toy

enitoys.name: Tontaudistor
enitoys.info: Tontaudistor create grunge music through harsh vocals, heavy rhythms, and deliberately distorted sound. Their performances are loud, messy, and often leave the surrounding area covered in scratches and scorch marks. Despite their rebellious attitudes, they are deeply loyal to anyone who respects their music.

nameOrigins.description: a small, wild North American rabbit with brownish-gray fur and a short, fluffy tail that is white on the underside
Focused on audible sound, as opposed to sight
(transitive) To bring something out of shape, to misshape

enitoys.name: Tadpoi
enitoys.info: Tadpoi produce toxic substances within their small bodies and release them into the water when threatened. Ponds inhabited by large groups of Tadpoi can develop a purple film across the surface. As they grow, their organs begin changing so they can safely process the very toxins they once created.

nameOrigins.description: A young toad or frog in its larval stage of development that lives in water, has a tail and no legs, and, like a fish, breathes through gills
A substance that is harmful or lethal to a living organism when ingested

enitoys.name: Panacrana
enitoys.info: Panacrana use specialized organs to absorb toxins and convert them into a safe medicinal substance. This substance can strengthen the immune system and help living creatures recover from sickness. Panacrana often gather near polluted water, where they work until the surrounding area is safe again.

nameOrigins.description: A remedy believed to cure all disease and prolong life that was originally sought by alchemists; a cure-all
Latin for frog

enitoys.name: Odover
enitoys.info: Odover hover above ponds by beating their wings so quickly that they produce a constant vibrating hum. They patrol the water's surface in search of small prey and rarely land for more than a few moments. As their bodies mature, a hard layer begins forming beneath their green exoskeleton.

nameOrigins.description: the insect order that contains dragonflies and damselflies
(transitive) to remain suspended in the air

enitoys.name: Glidra
enitoys.info: Glidra are coated in a grey, rock-like exoskeleton that gives their bodies a vaguely dragon-like appearance. Their thin wing membranes harden into transparent glass-like panels, allowing them to glide across ponds without constantly flapping. They use powerful bursts of air to gain height before silently swooping toward their targets.

nameOrigins.description: (intransitive) To move softly, smoothly, or effortlessly
A mythical reptilian or serpentine creature

enitoys.name: Axolittle
enitoys.info: Axolittle hide beneath the soft mud at the bottom of ponds, leaving only their feathery gills exposed. They are curious enough to bite almost anything lowered into the water, which makes fishing the easiest way to find them. Minerals from the mud gradually collect within their bodies as they grow.

nameOrigins.description: A critically endangered salamander found in the elevated lakes of Mexico, Ambystoma mexicanum
Small, not large, limited, particularly

enitoys.name: Axolarge
enitoys.info: Axolarge develop thick, mineral-hardened bodies that are too heavy for graceful swimming. Instead, they walk along the bottom of ponds and use their great strength to push aside rocks, sunken logs, and other obstacles. Groups of Axolittle often gather around them for protection.

nameOrigins.description: A critically endangered salamander found in the elevated lakes of Mexico, Ambystoma mexicanum
Of considerable or relatively great size or extent

enitoys.name: Mossker
enitoys.info: Mossker are small kitten-shaped Enitoys made entirely of living moss. When startled, they flatten their bodies against rocks, logs, and other forest structures to disguise themselves as ordinary patches of moss. Many travelers walk past them without ever realizing they were there.

nameOrigins.description: Any of various small, green, seedless plants growing on the ground or on the surfaces of trees, stones, etc.; now specifically, a plant of the phylum Bryophyta (formerly division Musci)
That part of the beard which grows upon the sides of the face, usually of the male, or upon the chin, or upon both

enitoys.name: Egernutty
enitoys.info: Egernutty constantly climb trees in search of nuts, even when their cheeks and large tails are already packed full of them. They seem unable to resist collecting any nut they find and often forget where they have hidden their excess stores. Shaking a tree may cause a startled Egernutty to fall from the branches along with several of its nuts.

nameOrigins.description: Danish for squirrel
Containing nuts

enitoys.name: Flyvegern
enitoys.info: Flyvegern spread the membranes between their limbs to glide rapidly from tree to tree. They use even the slightest breeze to reach distant branches in search of nuts, despite their cheeks and tails already being stuffed full. When strong winds blow, groups of Flyvegern can travel across an entire forest without touching the ground.

nameOrigins.description: Danish for flying squirrel

enitoys.name: Flitmaus
enitoys.info: Flitmaus are blind Enitoys that rely entirely on echolocation to find their way through the dark and always return home. They use toxins in their saliva to melt down fruits and bugs before eating them. Despite common belief, Flitmaus do not drink blood.

nameOrigins.description: to move, fly, or pass quickly and lightly from one place or condition to another
German for Mouse

enitoys.name: Necoin
enitoys.info: Necoin disguise themselves as lost coin purses in busy streets and marketplaces. When someone reaches down to pick one up, it springs to life and snaps at their hand. Despite their small size, the possessed coins packed inside their bodies make them surprisingly heavy.

nameOrigins.description: related to death or the dead
a small, flat, and usually round piece of metal issued by a government to be used as money

enitoys.name: Mimonead
enitoys.info: Mimonead float effortlessly despite their immense weight, using the spirit within their wooden bodies to keep themselves aloft. The coins overflowing from their chests move as though alive, forming long arms and a tongue that they use to grab anything they mistake for treasure. Each Mimonead is believed to have formed after a Necoin amassed far more coins than its original body could contain.

nameOrigins.description: type of folkloric or mythical creature that disguises itself as a human or another living being in order to deceive others
A generally accepted means of exchange
beings in mythology, legend, or fiction that are deceased but behave as if they were alive

enitoys.name: Tanubbish
enitoys.info: Tanubbish roam city streets searching through bins for anything they consider useful. They stuff their finds into the trash bag that forms their tail, often collecting far more than they need. When threatened, they hurl pieces of junk from the bag before quickly scurrying away.

nameOrigins.description: A raccoon dog, Nyctereutes viverrinus
(chiefly Commonwealth) Refuse, waste, garbage, junk, trash

enitoys.name: Chewattster
enitoys.info: Chewattster are drawn to electrical wires and will nibble through their insulation to absorb the static energy within. They store excess energy in their cheeks, causing their fur to stand on end when fully charged. Power outages in goldenstead city are often blamed on groups of Chewattster nesting near electrical equipment.

nameOrigins.description: To crush with the teeth by repeated closing and opening of the jaws; done to food to soften it and break it down by the action of saliva before it is swallowed
In the International System of Units, the derived unit of power; the power of a system in which one joule of energy is transferred per second
Any of various Old World rodent species belonging to the subfamily Cricetinae

enitoys.name: Foodunite
enitoys.info: Foodunite are cheerful yeti-like Enitoy that spend the day preparing fresh breads, pastries, and other warm meals. The heat radiating from their bodies allows them to bake food without an oven, and they happily share what they make with anyone nearby. As evening approaches, they retreat to rest while Foodunter begin to emerge.

nameOrigins.description: (uncountable) Any solid substance that can be consumed by living organisms, especially by eating, in order to sustain life
Having completed or finished an activity
(transitive) To set fire to (something), to light (something)

enitoys.name: Foodunter
enitoys.info: Foodunter are calm yeti-like Enitoy that emerge at night to prepare frozen desserts and other chilled foods. The cold radiating from their bodies can freeze ingredients without ice, and they happily share what they make with anyone nearby. As morning approaches, they retreat to rest while Foodunite begin to emerge.

nameOrigins.description: (uncountable) Any solid substance that can be consumed by living organisms, especially by eating, in order to sustain life
Having completed or finished an activity

Traditionally the fourth of the four seasons, typically regarded as spanning either the period between the winter solstice to the spring equinox, or the months of December, January, and February in temperate and polar regions of the Northern Hemisphere and the months of June, July, and August in the Southern Hemisphere. It is the time when the sun is lowest in the sky, resulting in short days,

enitoys.name: Cactuty
enitoys.info: Cactuty patrol the desert in search of trouble, acting as self-appointed deputies to any Enitoy or traveler in need. They use their sharp spines to drive off threats and will stand their ground even against opponents far larger than themselves. When a Cactuty claims an area as its patrol, it will return to check on it every day.

nameOrigins.description: (botany) Any member of the family Cactaceae, a family of flowering New World succulent plants suited to a hot, semi-desert climate
One appointed as the substitute of others, and empowered to act for them, in their name or their behalf; a substitute in office

enitoys.name: Deseriff
enitoys.info: Deseriff patrol the desert like sheriffs, protecting travelers and weaker Enitoy from danger. They can fire their cactus needles and small sharpened pebbles with enough force and accuracy to strike like bullets. When outnumbered, they fling pockets of sand into their foes' eyes to temporarily blind them before quickly taking control of the situation.

nameOrigins.description: A barren area of land or desolate terrain, especially one with little water or vegetation; a wasteland
(UK, except Scotland) (High Sheriff) An official of a shire or county office, responsible for carrying out court orders, law enforcement and other duties

enitoys.name: Sandash
enitoys.info: Sandash dash across open deserts at high speed, using their long legs to race over loose sand and rocky ground without slowing down. They rarely fly, instead using their wings to steady themselves while making sharp turns. When threatened, they kick sand and small stones behind them before quickly running away.

nameOrigins.description: (uncountable) Rock that is ground more finely than gravel, but is not as fine as silt (more formally, see grain sizes chart), forming beaches and deserts and also used in construction
run

enitoys.name: Ziprint
enitoys.info: Ziprint can run so quickly that static electricity builds across their feathers and crackles around their legs. They release this stored energy through powerful kicks while charging past opponents at full speed. The trails of dust and sparks left behind a running Ziprint can remain visible long after it has disappeared into the distance.

nameOrigins.description: slang to run
A short race at top speed

enitoys.name: Scorpinch
enitoys.info: Scorpinch burrow beneath loose sand and rocks to escape the desert heat, emerging quickly when prey or danger approaches. Their hard bodies allow them to adapt to rough terrain, while the toxins in their stingers can weaken much larger opponents. Although they rarely attack without reason, a provoked Scorpinch will aggressively chase its attacker until it believes the threat has passed.

nameOrigins.description: Any of the order Scorpiones of arachnids related to spiders, characterised by two large front pincers and a curved tail with a venomous sting at the end
To squeeze a small amount of a person's skin and flesh, making it hurt

enitoys.name: Buzzareap
enitoys.info: Buzzareap are said to be living shadows that carry souls to the afterlife by devouring them. If you see a single Buzzareap, hope that it hasn't seen you as they rarely travel by themself. And if you see a flock of them, just know you can run and you can try to hide, but they will find you and they will try to take your soul with them.

nameOrigins.description: Any of several Old World birds of prey of the genus Buteo with broad wings and a broad tail
A personification of Death as an old man, or a skeleton, carrying a scythe, taking souls to the afterlife

enitoys.name: Barkodamask
enitoys.info: Barkodamask are small faceless spirits that hide their heads behind masks made from tree bark. They are extremely reluctant to let anyone see what lies beneath, and will quickly turn away or cover themselves if their mask is removed. Despite their eerie appearance, many Barkodamask are curious creatures that quietly follow people from a distance.

nameOrigins.description: All the tissues of a tree external to the vascular cambium; includes epidermis, cortex and phloem
(Japanese mythology) A type of Japanese tree spirit
A cover, or partial cover, for the face, used for disguise or protection

enitoys.name: Nickodamask
enitoys.info: Nickodamask form their physical bodies around heavy metal masks, making them noticeably tougher and heavier than their other forms. The metal of each mask gradually becomes scratched and dented through battle, but a Nickodamask will become extremely agitated if anyone other than its Tamer attempts to repair or remove it.

nameOrigins.description: hard, silvery-white transition metal
(Japanese mythology) A type of Japanese tree spirit
A cover, or partial cover, for the face, used for disguise or protection

enitoys.name: Terrakodamask
enitoys.info: Terrakodamask wear terracotta masks that they carefully decorate with scratched symbols, paint, and small imperfections. No two masks are ever completely alike. When one is cracked, the Terrakodamask will patiently repair it with clay rather than replace it, sometimes leaving the crack visible as though it were an important memory.

nameOrigins.description: A hard red-brown unglazed earthenware, used for pottery and building construction
(Japanese mythology) A type of Japanese tree spirit
A cover, or partial cover, for the face, used for disguise or protection

enitoys.name: Brawrap
enitoys.info: Brawrap use their shed skin wrapped around their front feet to act as boxing gloves when attacking prey or defending themselves. This shed skin has a very rubbery quality that allows it to spring back into shape after absorbing the force of Brawrap's powerful kinetic punches.

nameOrigins.description: A disorderly argument or fight, usually with a large number of people involved
(transitive) To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper

enitoys.name: Skinetic
enitoys.info: Upon modifying into Skinetic, the force behind its punches now feels as though it seriously intends to do more than just harm the opponent. Scientists have measured an average Skinetic to punch with around 75,800 pounds of force in a single punch, while holding back. It is advised to avoid Brawrap nests in case a Skinetic is nearby.

nameOrigins.description: (uncountable) The outer protective layer of the body of any animal, including of a human
Relating to motion

enitoys.name: Crustone
enitoys.info: Crustone are small crabs that tend to live in dark environments such as caves as they can blend in with the stalagmites and stalactites to hide from potential predators and prey. However Crustone meat is often seen as a local delicacy served with butter and seasonings in port towns across the globe.

nameOrigins.description: Any arthropod of the subphylum Crustacea, including lobsters, crabs, shrimp, barnacles and woodlice
(uncountable, geology) A hard earthen substance that can form rocks; especially, such substance when regarded as a building material

enitoys.name: Yowarab
enitoys.info: Upon modifying into these frigid yowarabs, they are no longer hunted for food as they are the average size of a person. However, due to sightings of these beasts being rare, photos of them in the wild are even rarer and are for some reason almost always blurry. Meaning if people didn't know Crustone modified into them, Yowarab would be thought of as a hoax.

nameOrigins.description: (Australia, cryptozoology) An ape-like monster or animal said to exist in parts of eastern Australia
a state of usually open and declared armed hostile conflict between states, nations, or organized groups
Any crustacean of the infraorder Brachyura, having five pairs of legs, the foremost of which are in the form of claws, and a carapace

enitoys.name: Rattling
enitoys.info: Rattling shake the rattles on their tails whenever they feel threatened or excited. Despite their attempts to intimidate others, the sound closely resembles a child's toy rattle, causing many people to find them cute rather than frightening.

nameOrigins.description: Any of various venomous American snakes, of genera Crotalus and Sistrurus, having a rattle at the end of its tail
A newly hatched bird, reptile or other animal that has emerged from an egg

enitoys.name: Cobrattle
enitoys.info: Cobrattle spread the large hoods around their necks and violently shake their tails when threatened. Unlike the playful rattle of a Rattling, a Cobrattle's rattle produces a deep, harsh sound that can be heard from far away. Their fangs contain a potent venom, and they prefer to strike from dark places before their prey can react.

nameOrigins.description: Any of the genus Naja of venomous snakes that can spread their neck ribs into a broad hood when threatened; a true cobra
A contest, a struggle

enitoys.name: Princub
enitoys.info: Princub are small desert-dwelling Enitoy that move quietly through sandy and rocky terrain in search of prey. Despite their young age, they carry themselves with unusual confidence and are rarely seen acting timid. If a Princub is threatened, nearby Purraoh are known to arrive quickly to defend it.

nameOrigins.description: (now archaic or historical) A (male) ruler, a sovereign; a king, monarch
the young offspring of certain carnivorous animals

enitoys.name: Purraoh
enitoys.info: Purraoh are imposing stone Enitoy that watch over desert territories from elevated rocks and ancient ruins. They are highly protective of Princub and will quickly confront anything they believe poses a threat to them. Despite their heavy bodies, Purraoh move with surprising grace and are known to silently observe opponents before choosing the perfect moment to strike.

nameOrigins.description: (intransitive, of a cat) To make a vibrating sound in its throat when contented or in certain other conditions

(historical) The supreme ruler of Ancient Egypt; a formal address for the sovereign seat of power as personified by the "king" in an institutional role of Horus son of Osiris; often used by metonymy for Ancient Egyptian sovereignty

enitoys.name: Antinnian
enitoys.info: Antinnian was once part of a single wooden totem before awakening as its own Enitoy. After hearing a voice from within the darkness, it began repeating the sound through low hums that caused the corruption to spread to anything that listened.

nameOrigins.description: Opposed to something
(otolaryngology, pathology) The experience of auditory sensations, such as a ringing or pulsating sound, occurring in the absence of any external stimulus
Of or pertaining to apes and monkeys

enitoys.name: Antisian
enitoys.info: Antisian was carved from the same totem as Antinnian and Antictian. After witnessing the darkness directly, shadowy patterns formed across its wooden body, and those who met its gaze began seeing the same corrupting visions.

nameOrigins.description: Opposed to something
(uncountable) The sense or ability of sight
Of or pertaining to apes and monkeys

enitoys.name: Antictian
enitoys.info: Antictian unknowingly gave the darkness a voice after speaking words it did not understand. Each time it repeated them, the corruption spread farther, until the darkness became permanently embedded within all three pieces of the broken totem.

nameOrigins.description: Opposed to something
Choice and use of words, especially with regard to effective communication; the effectiveness and degree of clarity of word choice and expression
Of or pertaining to apes and monkeys

enitoys.name: Discorideus
enitoys.info: Discorideus feeds on fearful dreams and spreads nightmares throughout the mindscape. Its rage ignites the darkest thoughts of sleeping minds, and its endless conflict with Discoroideus once weakened Equcideus enough to shatter the barrier between dreams and reality.

nameOrigins.description: Lack of concord, agreement, harmony; disaccord
extremely unpleasant, dreadful, or unkind
Latin for god

enitoys.name: Discoroideus
enitoys.info: Discoroideus shapes beautiful reveries so vivid that dreamers may refuse to awaken. It seeks to replace fear and sorrow with endless fantasy, and its endless conflict with Discorideus once weakened Equcideus enough to shatter the barrier between dreams and reality.

nameOrigins.description: Lack of concord, agreement, harmony; disaccord
a psychiatric condition marked by dream-like disturbances of consciousness
Latin for god

enitoys.name: Shindogust
enitoys.info: Shindogust was born when an ancient spirit became fused with a clay figure that had survived for countless generations. Its psychic power allows it to draw forgotten memories from objects and reveal events that occurred long ago.

nameOrigins.description: Japanese for dead
earthen clay figure
The first Roman emperor that the month August is named after causing people to switch from the Roman calendar to the Gregorian calendar in 8 BCE

enitoys.name: Shindogual
enitoys.info: Shindogual perceives everything occurring around it with perfect clarity. The spirit within its clay body uses its psychic power to sense even the smallest change in the present, making it nearly impossible to catch unaware.

nameOrigins.description: Japanese for dead
earthen clay figure
(chiefly theology) relating to a person's acts or deeds; active, practical

enitoys.name: Shindogure
enitoys.info: Shindogure constantly observes countless possible futures through its psychic power. Strange static energy escapes from its clay body whenever the future begins to change, though no one can determine which possibility it has seen.

nameOrigins.description: Japanese for dead
earthen clay figure
The time ahead; those moments yet to be experienced

enitoys.name: Equcideus
enitoys.info: Equcideus maintains the balance between dreams and nightmares throughout the world. It is said that every sleeping mind briefly enters its domain, where it shapes fantasies, fears, and memories into dreams. Should this balance be disturbed, the boundary between dreams and reality may begin to collapse.

nameOrigins.description: The condition of a system in which competing influences are balanced, resulting in no net change
Clear; easily understood
Latin for god

enitoys.name: Axolegion
enitoys.info: Axolegion carry large groups of Axolittle within muddy, water-filled hollows across their broad backs. Through movements of their gills and tail, they command the Axolittle to leap forward and attack as a coordinated unit. Despite their intimidating power, they carefully gather every Axolittle back after a battle.

nameOrigins.description: A critically endangered salamander found in the elevated lakes of Mexico, Ambystoma mexicanum
Numerous; vast; very great in number

enitoys.name: Novood
enitoys.info: Novood are young yeti-like Enitoy that eagerly try to help prepare meals despite their lack of experience. They frequently drop ingredients, mix up recipes, and make a mess of their workspace, but rarely become discouraged. As they gain experience, they develop a preference for preparing either warm or chilled foods.

overrides.info: When this Skinetic was flooded with cosmic infinity energy, the overpowering energy petrified the shed skin that its boxing gloves were made out of turning into its now-large stone gauntlets. Average Skinetic can punch their way through a boulder with a single punch while this single Skinetic can do the same to a mountain. Being flooded with that much energy is painful to Skinetic causing it to be constantly ready for an attack with four of its own.
